response.sql: WITH per_name AS (SELECT e.event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS avg_amt FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING AVG(b.amount) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amt) AS overall_avg FROM per_name), kept AS (SELECT p.event_name, p.avg_amt, p.avg_amt - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall FROM per_name p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_amt > o.overall_avg) SELECT event_name, avg_amt AS average_budgeted_amount, diff_from_overall, avg_amt / (SELECT AVG(avg_amt) FROM kept) AS ratio_to_kept_average FROM kept

assumptions.assumption: Event names whose budget amounts are all NULL have no average and are excluded from the overall average (each name counts once).
Events are grouped by event_name, so distinct events sharing a name are pooled into one average over all their budget lines.
